rows.basis: 2 × ¥788 weekday lunch / 2 × ¥1,688 seasonal / 2 × ¥2,288 signature, each +15% service charge. Calculated from the operator menu; not a quoted total for two.
rows.evidence: Operator menu prints ¥788 / ¥1,688 / ¥2,288 per person and 'A 15% Service Charge Will Be Added'.

rows.basis: 2 × ¥40 low-season ticket (1 Nov–31 Mar); optional galleries +¥10 each per person, so +¥20 for two if both are added. Calculated from the official tariff; no 'couple ticket' exists.
rows.evidence: Official Tickets table: ¥40 low season, ¥10 Treasure Gallery, ¥10 Gallery of Clocks.

rows.total_for_two: ¥888 (Classic Dim Sum Lunch Set for Two) or ¥2,288 (All Day Set Menu for Two)
rows.basis: Official set-menu PDF labels both as 'FOR TWO' and states prices are inclusive of service charge and taxes.
rows.evidence: PDF headings: 'CLASSIC DIM SUM LUNCH SET FOR TWO ¥888', 'ALL DAY SET MENU FOR TWO ¥2,288'.

rows.basis: 2 × ¥30 off-season adult ticket (1 Dec–31 Mar), which covers all trip dates. Calculated from the official tariff.
rows.evidence: Official 豫园票价: 淡季（12月1日至3月31日）成人每位30元.
